# What does this stump job really cost you, and what should you bid?

> Free stump grinding price calculator. Stump diameters, wood hardness, grinder speed, crew, machine and drive time in; price per stump, minimum charge, per-inch quote check and bundling out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/stump-grinding-price-calculator/)
